_comment: Corex Panel Preconfigured Template: Minecraft Multi-Engine (Paper, Purpur, Velocity) with Aikar's Flags
name: Corex Minecraft Multi-Engine (Paper, Purpur, Velocity)
author: support@corexpanel.com
description: High-performance Minecraft server with automated engine installer (Paper 1.21+, Purpur, or Velocity Proxy) and enterprise Aikar's JVM GC optimization flags.

installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
# Corex Multi-Engine Minecraft Installer (Paper, Purpur, Velocity)
apk add --no-cache curl jq

cd /mnt/server

ENGINE="${SERVER_ENGINE:-paper}"
VERSION="${MINECRAFT_VERSION:-1.21.4}"
JARFILE="${SERVER_JARFILE:-server.jar}"

echo "=================================================="
echo " Corex Multi-Engine Installer"
echo " Target Engine  : ${ENGINE}"
echo " Target Version : ${VERSION}"
echo " Output JAR     : ${JARFILE}"
echo "=================================================="

if [ "${ENGINE}" = "purpur" ]; then
    echo "Fetching Purpur build for version ${VERSION}..."
    DOWNLOAD_URL="https://api.purpurmc.org/v2/purpur/${VERSION}/latest/download"
    curl -sSL "${DOWNLOAD_URL}" -o "${JARFILE}"
elif [ "${ENGINE}" = "velocity" ]; then
    echo "Fetching latest Velocity proxy build..."
    LATEST_BUILD=$(curl -s https://api.papermc.io/v2/projects/velocity/versions/3.3.0-SNAPSHOT | jq '.builds[-1]')
    DOWNLOAD_URL="https://api.papermc.io/v2/projects/velocity/versions/3.3.0-SNAPSHOT/builds/${LATEST_BUILD}/downloads/velocity-3.3.0-SNAPSHOT-${LATEST_BUILD}.jar"
    curl -sSL "${DOWNLOAD_URL}" -o "${JARFILE}"
else
    # Default to Paper
    echo "Fetching latest Paper build for version ${VERSION}..."
    BUILDS_JSON=$(curl -s "https://api.papermc.io/v2/projects/paper/versions/${VERSION}")
    LATEST_BUILD=$(echo "${BUILDS_JSON}" | jq '.builds[-1]')
    if [ -z "${LATEST_BUILD}" ] || [ "${LATEST_BUILD}" = "null" ]; then
        echo "Warning: specific build not found, falling back to 1.21.1"
        VERSION="1.21.1"
        LATEST_BUILD=$(curl -s "https://api.papermc.io/v2/projects/paper/versions/${VERSION}" | jq '.builds[-1]')
    fi
    DOWNLOAD_URL="https://api.papermc.io/v2/projects/paper/versions/${VERSION}/builds/${LATEST_BUILD}/downloads/paper-${VERSION}-${LATEST_BUILD}.jar"
    echo "Downloading Paper build #${LATEST_BUILD}..."
    curl -sSL "${DOWNLOAD_URL}" -o "${JARFILE}"
fi

# Accept EULA automatically if configured
if [ "${EULA}" = "true" ]; then
    echo "eula=true" > /mnt/server/eula.txt
    echo "Minecraft EULA accepted."
fi

echo "Corex Multi-Engine installation finished successfully!"

variables.name: Server Engine
variables.description: Select your Minecraft software engine: 'paper', 'purpur', or 'velocity'.

variables.name: Server JAR File
variables.description: The executable JAR name to launch in container.

variables.name: Accept Minecraft EULA
variables.description: Automatically accept the Mojang End User License Agreement (https://account.mojang.com/documents/minecraft_eula).
